title: Ethiopia Presses for Red Sea Access Amid Post-War Regional Tensions
detail: Ethiopia is leveraging its post-Tigray war influence to push for a maritime corridor to the Red Sea, seeking to secure access to vital shipping lanes. Regional tensions remain elevated as Addis Ababa intensifies diplomatic pressure for a permanent outlet to the sea.

media.caption: Berbera Port in Somaliland, a key Red Sea access point Ethiopia has sought to leverage
